praeteritum imperfectum

the imperfect tense

The unfinished past: legēbam, I was reading, used to read. Donatus (fourth century) lists five tenses for conjugating a verb: praesēns, praeteritum inperfectum, praeteritum perfectum, praeteritum plūsquamperfectum, futūrum. The schools shorten it to imperfectum. Lewis & Short has no entry for the tense name. In the imperfect tense: tempore praeteritō imperfectō (Traupman 246).

Examples

  • Dīc praeteritum imperfectum. — Canēbam.

    Give the imperfect. — Canēbam.Traupman 241

See also tense, past tense, perfect tense, grammar.
